title: We Quo Mauney
transcription:
We Quo Mauney
Split Group
phonetic spellings are more or less thus:

We quo mauney, mauney, mauney,
mauney kushnic,
um-paqui, um-paqui,

We quo mauney, mauney, mauney,
mauney kushnic,
um-paqui, um-paquos,
Oh nicodeemo, Oh galee-galee ohmo,
Oh nicodeemo, Oh galee-galee, um-
pah, um-pah, um-pah

One half of group sings verse again, while
other half repeats the 'um-pah' as rhythm for
the first group. Switch parts and repeat.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Several nonsense/phonetic words are uncertain.
